title: KHR_node_lookat_target glTF Node Extension
description: Identifies a node as a passive positional marker whose evaluated per-instance global translation is the target point. The marker does not select a downstream system or cause orientation behavior.

hint.description: Nonempty advisory label suggesting an intended use. Values are exact and case-sensitive. No standard values are defined, and vendor-qualified values such as 'ACME_eye_target' are recommended. A value's meaning comes only from a separate specification or application profile; this extension defines no behavior for it.
